prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web interface direction comp
Primary request: Design a premium 1600x1000 desktop web interface for COVENANT, titled “Security Print Instrument,” inspired by a central-bank specimen and a modern bond certificate. This is a real full-bleed website screenshot, not a device mockup and not a poster.

Scene/backdrop: A refined ivory application canvas with midnight navy framing and precise financial-document structure. The main content is one monumental horizontal split financial instrument spanning most of the viewport.

Subject and layout:
- Top navigation with the COVENANT wordmark on the left, nav items “Protocol”, “Evidence”, “Risk”, and “Docs”, plus a clear outlined action “View public evidence” on the right.
- Strong modern editorial headline above the instrument: “Credit lines unlock only when external obligations are cryptographically proven.”
- Supporting line: “A causal credit protocol where verified repayment evidence controls every draw.”
- The monumental instrument is split into three connected zones:
  1. Left zone: large denomination “5 USDC” with label “External obligation” and compact metadata “Invoice 0417 · Due 24 Sep · Ethereum”.
  2. Center zone: cryptographic proof seal and vertical security thread, labeled “PROOF VERIFIED”, with restrained embossed COVENANT monogram and fine microtext.
  3. Right zone: large denomination “4 CTC” with label “Credit drawn” and compact metadata “Covenant Line 0082 · Active”.
- Show causal proof steps as a single linear sequence integrated beneath the instrument, not separate cards: “01 Obligation issued” → “02 Payment observed” → “03 Proof attested” → “04 Credit released”.
- Include exactly six evidence links in one refined ledger-like strip, not a generic card grid: “Payment receipt”, “Oracle attestation”, “Merkle proof”, “Credit agreement”, “Risk policy”, “Onchain record”.
- Add small serial details such as “CVN 000082”, “Proof epoch 1842”, “Chain finality 32/32”, and a tiny status “PUBLIC · VERIFIED”.

Style/medium: polished product UI screenshot, editorial fintech interface, central-bank specimen precision, bond-certificate composition, modern SaaS usability. Fine guilloche linework, restrained emboss, engraved borders, serial ink, security-thread geometry, crisp vector-like UI rendering, clean readable typography, strong hierarchy, generous whitespace.

Color palette: warm ivory, midnight navy, cobalt blue, oxblood red, pale mint accents. High contrast and restrained color use.

Typography: COVENANT wordmark in spaced uppercase engraved serif. Headlines use a modern high-contrast serif. Navigation, labels, serials, and evidence links use clean grotesk and monospaced utility type.

Text requirements: Render all specified interface text verbatim and legibly. Preserve the exact numbers “5 USDC” and “4 CTC”.

Constraints: one coherent desktop website view at 1600x1000, edge-to-edge browser canvas, production-ready interface, practical navigation and action controls, no browser chrome, no device frame, no presentation board, no explanatory callouts outside the UI.

Avoid: vintage ornamental overload, baroque flourishes, crypto coins, token illustrations, fake charts, generic dashboard card grids, glassmorphism, neon gradients, purple gradients, glowing effects, 3D coins, people, stock photography, watermark, poster composition.
